rationale: Inconsistent loading states create a disjointed user experience. Users see different loading indicators on different screens, making the app feel unpolished. A unified system improves perceived quality and predictability.
problemSolved: Multiple loading approaches: 1) Lottie-based LoadingSpinner with sizes small/medium/large, 2) TraktLoadingSpinner for Trakt operations, 3) DogLoadingSpinner, 4) SkeletonLoaders for home screen, 5) SearchSkeletonLoader, 6) Raw ActivityIndicator scattered throughout. Some screens use skeleton shimmer, others use spinners, creating visual inconsistency.
